title: External agent orchestration
text: MCP exposes deterministic capture, replay, mutation, scope, scanning, evidence, and finding tools. Actions remain recorded in History, Activity, and findings.

title: API and MCP
text: REST control API, SSE event stream, and full MCP server expose the same deterministic engine to scripts and agents.

title: Authorization testing
text: Replay requests as saved identities and diff responses for broken access control. OOB catcher supports blind callbacks when explicitly enabled.

title: Custom checks and rule packs
text: Sandboxed Starlark passive and active checks extend scanner behavior without a fork, with official and community bundles.

title: Message codecs
text: Project-scoped Starlark encrypt/decrypt helpers provide decoded views and opt-in re-encoding for application payloads.

title: Collaboration and remote access
text: Scoped and expiring API keys, key-authorized remote access, browser login, one-click Cloudflare tunnel, and project pull/push merge.

title: Guided content discovery
text: Run feroxbuster, ffuf, or similar tools through the proxy from Map and cluster soft-404 responses.

title: External AI integration
text: External assistants connect through MCP or REST/SSE while Interseptor supplies deterministic tools and evidence. Model calls remain outside the binary.

title: Finding tags
text: Curated findings use report-scope tags and export grouping for cms, website, app, api, and out-of-scope work.

title: HTTP/2 upstream
text: Prefer h2 to origins while keeping the MITM client leg on HTTP/1.1.

title: Import and export
text: Import and export HAR files and portable project bundles containing flows, rules, scope, and settings.

title: Intercept workflow
text: Hold, edit, forward, or drop requests and responses with ordered match-and-replace rules.

title: Intercepting proxy
text: HTTP and HTTPS interception with on-demand local-CA leaf certificates, plus request and response hold, edit, forward, drop, and match-and-replace.

title: Intruder
text: Sniper, Pitchfork, and Race modes with thread and delay controls, payload processing, grep matching, extraction, anomalies, attack tabs, and run history.

title: Multi-project launcher
text: The launcher dashboard starts, stops, and discovers multiple project instances.

title: Live history
text: SQLite metadata and content-addressed bodies with searchable metadata, headers, tags, bounded body matching, and saved Starlark predicates.

title: Mobile device support
text: Android adb-based CA and proxy setup plus iOS profile and jailbroken-device SSH automation.

title: Model-free core
text: No provider keys, built-in chat, or autonomous pentest loop. External models use deterministic tools with scope enforcement and evidence recording.

title: Repeater
text: Multi-tab request replay with free editing, response inspection, and per-tab history.

title: Active scanning
text: Passive checks and deterministic active scanning inspect injection points and confirm hits with detectors. Active Starlark checks extend coverage.

title: Scanner
text: Built-in passive checks cover security headers, CORS, reflected parameters, secrets, cookies, authentication, and version disclosure.

title: Target scope
text: Include and exclude rules focus History, intercept gates, and scanner activity.

title: Session and auth injection
text: Apply Authorization or Cookie headers, refresh tokens with a token macro, and re-authenticate with a recorded login macro.

title: Signed rule packs
text: Ed25519 publisher signatures and manifest SHA-256 protect rule-pack provenance during install.

title: Project vault
text: Always-on archive storage supports multi-device backup, import, and merge through Tailscale Serve.

title: WebSocket
text: Capture ws and wss traffic per frame and replay it in a WebSocket Repeater.
